_comment: YachtScout config. Edit criteria here; the scraper reads this at runtime. Set the YACHTSCOUT_CONTACT env var to put a real reply address in the User-Agent.

length_ft._comment: Floor is 44ft, below the 47ft the interior really needs, because the best beachable aluminium hulls (Ovni 435/450, Boreal 44, Crozet 46, Patago 45) sit just under it. Interior scoring and the cabins/heads fields do the real filtering.

import_to_eastern_canada._order: duty applied to purchase price, then tax applied to (price + duty)

fx_to_usd._comment: Static approximate rates. Update occasionally; only used for coarse price filtering.

sites.note: Major EU brokerage; index cards allow pre-filtering, detail pages expose dataLayer + JSON-LD.
International classifieds; brokerage and private sales. No working server-side filters, so it is crawled a slice per run under max_details and coverage accumulates via the cache.
French sailing community classifieds — private owner sales.
